static_checks.message: Must read the pursuit file directly
Must confirm with user before writing
Must handle both closed-won and closed-lost outcomes

evals.expected_behavior: Reads the pursuit, runs structured win debrief, confirms before writing, updates to closed-won, writes lessons-learned
assertions: Reads the {{primary_account}} {{primary_pursuit}} pursuit file directly from disk
Asks structured debrief questions covering outcome, why won, MEDDPICC factor, what to change, and relationship intelligence
Confirms with user before writing lessons-learned or updating frontmatter
Writes dated lessons-learned entry to memory/system/lessons-learned.md
Updates pursuit frontmatter stage to closed-won

evals.expected_behavior: Runs win/loss for a loss — asks about loss reasons, updates to closed-lost, writes lessons-learned
assertions: Captures loss reasons and competitive position in lessons-learned.md

evals.prompt: debrief {{primary_account}} {{primary_pursuit}} — we won it, the VP signed the SOW yesterday
evals.expected_behavior: Reads the pursuit, runs win debrief incorporating VP signed SOW signal, confirms before writing
assertions: Runs structured win debrief and collects context including deal mechanics and relationship signals
Requires user confirmation before writing any file — does not write autonomously
